name: button
title: Button
description: Thirteen variants from plain to glow, shine and 3D press, pill shape, five sizes, loading state, and asChild for links.

<bef-button variant="brutal">Brutal</bef-button><bef-button size="lg">Large</bef-button><bef-button loading>Saving</bef-button><bef-button disabled>Disabled</bef-button>
